lean.fidelity_note: Both statements assert that a solution satisfying Theorem 1.1 can be chosen with a smooth extension through $T_*$ away from the origin, without requiring that extension to solve Euler after $T_*$. The formal proof obtains this existential conclusion from a particular auxiliary construction, rather than proving the broader auxiliary assertion for every admissible construction.
